messages.author: 883fdf7d10a85c28
messages.subject: Rhipe initialization error
parts:
Hello all,

I am trying to configure Rhipe on a hadoop cluster.

When initializing Rhipe on the hadoop cluster, I am getting the following error:

Initializing Rhipe v0.73

Error in .jnew("org/godhuli/rhipe/PersonalServer") :

  java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: org/apache/hadoop/io/Writable

 I was wondering if the hadoop version has an effect on Rhipe running properly? The hadoop version we are working with is version 2.2. Any insight you might have into resolving this issue would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,

Sri

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Rhipe initialization error
parts:
Right now , RHIPE is tested with Cloudera 4.
You need to set classpaths - for example

export HADOOP_LIBS=/usr/local/hadoopCDH4/hadoop-2.0.0-mr1-cdh4.2.1/:/usr/local/hadoopCDH4/hadoop-2.0.0-mr1-cdh4.2.1/lib
export HADOOP_LIBS=$HADOOP_LIBS:${HADOOP2}/share/hadoop/hdfs/
export HADOOP_LIBS=$HADOOP_LIBS:${HADOOP2}/share/hadoop/common/
export HADOOP_LIB=$HADOOP_LIBS:${HADOOP2}/share/hadoop/httpfs/:${HADOOP2}/share/hadoop/tools/
export HADOOP_HOME=/usr/local/hadoopCDH4/hadoop-2.0.0-mr1-cdh4.2.1/
export HBASE_HOME=/usr/lib/hbase
export HADOOP_CONF_DIR=/etc/mozilla.cluster.conf/conf.peach/hadoop
export HBASE_CONF_DIR=/etc/mozilla.cluster.conf/conf.peach/hbase
export PATH=/usr/local/hadoopCDH4/hadoop-2.0.0-mr1-cdh4.2.1/bin/:$PATH
